source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Emerging Technologies and Entrepreneurship (PDF 134, printed 130).

blocks.text: Emerging (nayi ubharti) technologies jaise artificial intelligence, cloud computing, blockchain aur mobile applications entrepreneurship ko badal rahi hain. Yeh technologies entrepreneurs ko zyada smart, tez aur behtar business hal banane mein madad deti hain. Yeh kharche kam karti, productivity barhati aur digital platforms ke zariye duniya bhar tak pohanch deti hain. Startups in technologies se aise naye products aur services banate hain jo aaj ke customers ki zarooratein poori karein. Nateeje mein emerging technologies duniya bhar mein digital entrepreneurship ke naye mauqe khol rahi hain.

blocks.prompt: Entrepreneurship badalne wali chaar emerging technologies ke naam likhein aur do fawaid batayein.
blocks.explanation: Artificial intelligence, cloud computing, blockchain aur mobile applications. Fawaid: kharch kam, productivity zyada, aur digital platforms se global reach (duniya bhar tak rasai).

items: AI, cloud, blockchain aur mobile apps entrepreneurship badal rahe hain.
Smart, tez aur behtar business solutions; duniya bhar mein naye mauqe.
